claims.sentence: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title><jats:sec><jats:title>Purpose</jats:title><jats:p>To analyse the neuroprotective effects of oral taurine administration in Royal College of Surgeons (RCS) rats.</jats:p></jats:sec><jats:sec><jats:title>Methods</jats:title><jats:p>Pigmented RCS rats (at postnatal day 21: P21) were administered taurine in drinking water (0.2 M) during 24 days.
